'If Hemorrhage Bore has an aim counter, it has "When this hits a hero, destroy a card in their arsenal."' Ranger Action - Arrow Attack (Dynasty).

DEVIATION FROM THE TRIAGE LIST, deliberate: triage named DESTROY_ARSENAL, but its handler destroys EVERY card in the arsenal (effect_types.py:2994-3008 loops all of player.arsenal.cards) with no choice - wrong for 'destroy A card', and it contradicts official_release_notes 1 ('if the hero hit has two or more cards in their arsenal, you choose which one'). Instead the destroy-one-with-choice behaviour is composed from verified primitives: LOOK_AT zone ARSENAL player OPPONENT amount ALL stores the whole arsenal as a list (zone map includes ARSENAL, effect_types.py:3390); SELECT_FROM_REF mode ANY min 1 max 1 asks the controller to pick exactly one at RESOLUTION time (release note 1's timing), degrades to a no-op when the arsenal is empty (empty pool -> loop never runs -> chosen=[]), and with min 1 the choice is mandatory whenever a card exists; DESTROY_REF destroys the picked card(s) via canonical destroy().

CONDITIONS: COUNTER_GTE reads counter_type/min (condition_types.py:998-1030) against THIS card's own counters tally - the handler's comment names the arsenal->combat-chain move for aim counters specifically and resolves it via the card-level tally, which is exactly this card's lifecycle. ATTACK_TARGET_IS_HERO (condition_types.py:1960) gates 'hits a hero' - false when the attack was declared at a permanent or ally. Conditions gate at resolution, so the trigger queues on every hit and fizzles harmlessly without an aim counter; consequently multiple aim counters still yield ONE instance per hit (official_release_notes 2) by construction - no extra authoring needed.

No printed keywords. Red printing; blue/yellow siblings differ only in colour.
